title: How is AI changing quantitative trading?
author: Apart-Speed-270
selftext:
I've been increasingly interested in how AI is being applied to quantitative trading.

AI tools are becoming more accessible, but I'm curious about how useful they really are in practical trading environments.

A few questions I'd love to discuss:

1. Can AI meaningfully improve market analysis and strategy development?
2. How important is backtesting when evaluating an AI-powered trading strategy?
3. What are the biggest challenges when combining machine learning with algorithmic trading?

I'd be interested in hearing from people who have actually experimented with these technologies.

What has your experience been so far?
